{{Top}}
An '''asteroid storm''' was a stellar phenomenon. [[Starship/Legends|Starships]] caught in asteroid storms could suffer catastrophic damage. The starship piloted by [[Jhensara]] was caught in an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] storm forcing her to deploy her [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]] [[Artoo (Jhensara)|Artoo]], [[Arfive (Jhensara)|Arfive]], and [[Arthree (Jhensara)|Arthree]] to repair the damage.
